caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a person standing on a rectangular wooden pedestal. The figure has medium brown skin and long, dark hair. They wear a blue garment with a green shoulder covering and gold trim, along with a yellow-green sash that crosses the chest and wraps around the waist. The person is also adorned with a black beaded necklace and a yellow and green headband, which supports a feathered headdress consisting of four large, pale blue feathers. The arms are relaxed with hands resting together at the front of the body. The figure's legs are bare except for green band-like decorations at the ankles, and the feet are bare. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, and the statue is centrally positioned on the page.
title: Cigar Store Indian
